about: A flame point (red point) colourpoint cat: a cream body with orange-red points, often on a sturdier domestic body than a show Siamese.

palette.tail and legs: faint darker barring in the points

rules: The points are graded into the body over several texels, never a hard edge.
Faint tabby barring shows on the tail and in the leg points; the body may carry a faint saddle of colour along the back.
